title: THE TWO-DOLLAR TRAP
caption: They pay $2 for videos. Then ask $250. The trap is the trust.

beats.name: THE HOOK
beats.vo: They pay you two dollars to watch videos. Then they ask for two hundred fifty.
beats.visual: Words fill the page as they're spoken.

beats.name: THE PIVOT
beats.vo: See, the job is real. The pay is real. The trap is the next step.
beats.visual: A phone screen with a video grid, a phrase circled by hand.
beats.text: THE JOB IS REAL. THE PAY IS REAL.
beats.footage: phone screen grid of short videos, finger tapping

beats.name: THE TRUST
beats.vo: Meaning the platform builds trust on purpose. Instant payouts. A balance that grows. Support that answers in minutes. None of it was real.
beats.visual: A checklist of trust signals, one by one.
beats.motion: Signals check in one at a time, then everything freezes and flips to fake.

beats.name: THE TRACE
beats.vo: But the balance on screen is not real. When you deposit two hundred fifty, the money moves. To their platform. Then to their wallet. Then gone.
beats.visual: A money flow trace, node to node.
beats.motion: The money travels the line, then the destination gets boxed.

beats.name: THE FUNNEL
beats.vo: And the scam runs on volume. A hundred thousand targets. A thousand responses. A hundred deposits. Five locked accounts.
beats.visual: A funnel narrowing from a hundred thousand targets to five locked accounts.

beats.name: THE PAYOFF
beats.vo: Therefore, paid to watch videos. Until the pay becomes the price.
beats.visual: Words fill the page as they're spoken.
